name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-map-clear-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get, remove; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:'; map:remove and value:cloneWithType are listed, but map:removeAll and value:cloneReadOnly are not.
reason: The asserted panic requires creating a readonly map with cloneReadOnly() and clearing it with map removeAll(). Both essential langlib operations are outside the explicit supported lists, so this is a feature case.
unsupported_constructs: map:removeAll() via method syntax, including its panic on a readonly map
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts runtime rejection of clearing a readonly map; array:removeAll support does not cover this map operation.
